JOB DESCRIPTION




Position Title :- AI Engineer




Experience Required :- 2+ years




Employment Type Full-time




Location:- Noida- 132




Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to join our team. This role combines deep technical expertise in generative AI with team leadership and project management responsibilities. The ideal candidate will drive the strategy and execution of our generative AI initiatives, mentor a team of AI engineers, and provide strategic input on AI product development and architecture decisions.




Key Responsibilities




• Provide strategic technical input on generative AI project planning, architecture, and technology selection




• Design, develop, and deploy production-grade generative AI solutions using LLMs, RAG systems, and fine-tuning techniques




• Lead code reviews and establish best practices for generative AI development and responsible AI deployment




• Collaborate with product and business teams to translate requirements into technical roadmaps and project milestones




• Evaluate and integrate emerging generative AI models, frameworks, and tools (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, etc.)




• Monitor and optimize LLM performance, cost efficiency, latency, and reliability in production environments




• Document architectural decisions, maintain technical documentation, and conduct knowledge-sharing sessions




Required Qualifications




• 2+ years of professional experience in generative AI, LLM development, or related AI/ML fields




• Proven experience working with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, RAG systems, or fine-tuning




• Strong software engineering fundamentals: Python, system design, API integration, and deployment pipelines




• Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring technical teams




• Experience with generative AI platforms and APIs (OpenAI GPT, Claude, Hugging Face, Azure OpenAI, etc.)




• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders Preferred Qualifications




• Hands-on experience with production generative AI systems at scale • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search technologies




• Experience with ML operations (MLOps), model monitoring, and evaluation metrics




• Knowledge of responsible AI, bias mitigation, and ethical AI practices




• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) for ML workloads




• Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or published research




• Advanced degree (Masters/PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or related field Core Competencies




• Technical Expertise: Generative AI, LLMs, deep learning, NLP, prompt engineering




• Leadership: Team management, mentoring, decision-making, stakeholder management




• Project Management: Agile methodologies, roadmap planning, prioritization




• Problem Solving: Complex system design, optimization, troubleshooting




• Communication: Clear documentation, presentations, cross-functional collaboration Project Input & Strategic Planning




• Participate in product roadmap discussions and provide technical feasibility assessments




• Identify technical risks, propose mitigation strategies, and manage technical debt




• Lead architecture reviews and ensure alignment with company technical standards




• Provide recommendations on tool selection, technology stack, and infrastructure decisions




• Contribute to hiring and team expansion planning

Key Responsibilities




Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI models

Build and maintain data pipelines for training and inference

Work on supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms

Implement NLP, Computer Vision, or Deep Learning solutions

Optimize models for performance, scalability, and accuracy

Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and product teams

Deploy models using cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Monitor model performance and perform continuous improvements

Conduct data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation

Document models, processes, and experiments





Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills




Strong proficiency in Python

Experience with Machine Learning libraries:




Scikit-learn

TensorFlow / PyTorch





Knowledge of data manipulation tools (Pandas, NumPy)

Experience with ML algorithms (regression, classification, clustering)

Familiarity with Deep Learning frameworks

Knowledge of NLP or Computer Vision techniques

Experience in model deployment (APIs, microservices)

Strong understanding of statistics and probability

About Info Edge India Ltd.

InfoEdge's mission is to create world-class platforms that transform lives by continuously innovating. Our products and services are built keeping our customers in mind. We always delight our customers by delivering superior value through enhanced offerings on the internet and other platforms. Through our continuous investment across various businesses, especially in cutting-edge technology, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), we have built a robust system that constantly increases our predictive powers on customer behaviour, and optimizes and improves our systems. Our various teams tirelessly work together to solve problems, innovate, and create something to empower our customers.

At Info Edge, people are our core competitive advantage and we will continue doing all that is needed to attract and retain the best available talent.

Business: Central Function -Data Science Team.

Title:  Lead AI Engineer 

Required Educational Qualification: BE/ B.Tech/MCA

Experience: 3-7 Years

Work Location: Noida (Sector 132)

Key Responsibilities




Design and develop a centralized ML platform, including feature store, model registry, experiment tracking, and serving layer.
Design and own model serving infrastructure, including real-time and batch inference pipelines with SLA-grade reliability.
Evaluate and implement inference optimization strategies, including quantization, tensor parallelism, vLLM/Triton-based serving, and TensorRT compilation.
Develop GenAI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agentic workflows, and knowledge retrieval systems.
Establish MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for ML, model versioning, drift detection, and automated retraining pipelines.
Design and maintain automated load-testing pipelines to benchmark model performance under peak and spike traffic conditions.
Implement advanced deployment strategies such as shadow testing to evaluate new model versions on live traffic without impacting user experience.
Partner with Data Scientists to productionize models by translating prototype code into scalable, maintainable production services and providing actionable feedback on infrastructure and engineering constraints.
Collaborate with Platform, DevOps, and Product Engineering teams to embed ML capabilities into the product stack.
Mentor and lead a team of 3–4 ML Engineers.


Required Skills

5–8 years of experience in ML Engineering, MLOps, or AI Platform roles.
Strong Python programming skills with experience building production-grade applications.
Hands-on experience building and deploying ML/AI systems in production environments.
Production experience with LLMs or large-scale deep learning models.
Experience with serving frameworks such as vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TorchServe, or BentoML.
Experience with inference optimization techniques including ONNX, TensorRT, quantization (INT8/FP16), 
Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar experiment tracking and pipeline orchestration tools.
Basic understanding of Data Science concepts, including classification, regression, clustering, ranking methods, and evaluation metrics.
Hands-on experience working with Vector Databases such as Milvus or Chroma.
Understanding of evaluation frameworks for Generative AI applications, such as DeepEval and Ragas.


Preferred Skills
Hands-on experience with feature stores (Feast, Tecton, or custom implementations).
Experience with data streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis for real-time ML.
Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning and PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA).
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar GenAI frameworks.
Understanding of model safety, fairness, and responsible AI principles.



Why Join Us: This is a unique opportunity to work on innovative and disruptive technologies that are shaping the future of the industry. We are looking for candidates who are willing to work passionately in a fast- paced environment and are ready to enhance their skills by learning something new. Being a part of the InfoEdge team, you will be engaged in innovations, product development, integration with mobile and social media, technology, research and development, quality assurance, sales and marketing.

To learn more about Info Edge visit :- http://www.infoedge.in/

measurable business impact.

mentor engineers, and act as the AI technical authority across product squads.

Technical Leadership
Lead architecture and end-to-end delivery of production GenAI applications, including
RAG pipelines, AI agents, and LLM-powered features.
Define and enforce engineering standards, best practices, and design patterns across AI
and backend systems.
Drive technical decision-making model selection, infrastructure choices, build vs buy
tradeoffs with a clear rationale.

engineers.

roadmap.

enterprise integrations.

for Redis, and vector databases (Azure AI Search, pgvector).

8+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years in a tech lead or principal

Deep expertise in Azure PaaS: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure ML, AKS, Azure

Proven ability to lead and grow engineering teams; track record of technical mentorship.
Strong system design skills able to design for scale, reliability, and cost-efficiency in
cloud-native environments.
Experience with fine-tuning LLMs using LoRA / QLoRA and managing training pipelines

Runtime, TGI).

Azure certifications (AI-102, AZ-204, AZ-305) or equivalent cloud credentials.
Experience with multimodal AI models (GPT-4o, vision, audio) or document intelligence

ownership.
